static_functions.name: OpenInviteDialog
static_functions.description: Opens the Steam Overlay invite dialog, so the player can invite Friends to the current server
static_functions.description_long:
Opens the Steam Overlay invite dialog, so the player can invite Friends to the current server.

When a Friend accepts, they join this server and Steam.GetJoinedFromFriend() returns this player's SteamID on their side. If they were already on this server, the FriendJoin event is called instead

static_functions.name: InviteFriend
static_functions.description: Invites a Steam Friend to the current server

parameters.name: steam_id
parameters.description: The SteamID of the Friend to invite

static_functions.name: GetJoinedFromFriend
static_functions.description: Gets the SteamID of the Friend whose invite or "Join Game" brought this player to the current server
static_functions.description_long:
Gets the SteamID of the Friend whose invite or "Join Game" brought this player to the current server, or nil if they connected any other way.

This value is reported by the client, so a server should not trust it blindly (e.g. ask the Friend to accept before adding the player to a private group).

examples.title: Puts a player in the party of the Friend who invited them
examples.content:
-- Client side
local function JoinFriendParty(friend_steam_id)
	Events.CallRemote("JoinFriendParty", friend_steam_id)
end

-- If we connected through an invite or "Join Game"
local friend_steam_id = Steam.GetJoinedFromFriend()
if (friend_steam_id) then
	JoinFriendParty(friend_steam_id)
end

-- If we accepted an invite to the server we are already on
Steam.Subscribe("FriendJoin", JoinFriendParty)

-- Server side
Events.SubscribeRemote("JoinFriendParty", function(player, friend_steam_id)
	for _, other in pairs(Player.GetAll()) do
		if (other:GetSteamID() == friend_steam_id) then
			-- Adds player to other's party
			break
		end
	end
end)

events.name: FriendJoin
events.description: Called when this player accepts a Friend's invite or "Join Game" to the server they are already on
events.description_long:
Called when this player accepts a Friend's invite or "Join Game" to the server they are already on. In this case the player does not reconnect.

When the player connects from another server or from the menus, use Steam.GetJoinedFromFriend() instead.
